question: In a ΔABC, the bisector of ∠A meets BC at D. If AB = 9.6 cm, AC = 11.2 cm and BD = 4.8 cm, the perimeter (in cm) of ΔABC is:
solution:
**Given:**

AB = 9.6 cm

AC = 11.2 cm

BD = 4.8 cm

**Concept used:**

Angle bisector theorem = The angle bisector of any angle will divide the opposite side in the ratio of the sides containing the angle.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e89573a74bef41851a8020a3784f8f91389953834d37e7ed4f698350c3b0ad46.png] 

According to the concept,

BD/CD = AB/AC

⇒ 4.8/CD = 9.6/11.2

⇒ 1/CD = 2/11.2

⇒ CD = 5.6

So, BC = 4.8 + 5.6

⇒ BC = 10.4

Now,

Perimeter of ΔABC = 9.6 + 10.4 + 11.2

⇒ 31.2 cm

**∴ The perimeter (in cm) of ΔABC is 31.2.**
